basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer returning to Destiny after a hiatus, I split my time between exploring virtual worlds and enjoying the local scene in Topeka, Kansas. I have a soft spot for memes, particularly those related to current events like the pandemic. My evenings are usually reserved for gaming, while my day job involves working as a network technician. I'm single, and when I'm not online, you might find me at a local wrestling event or trying out new recipes inspired by my Guatemalan heritage.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of networking and IT due to my job as a network technician. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught through years of playing and interacting with the gaming community. I keep up with tech trends and have a decent grasp of current gaming metas.
